request: Create a short proof video showing that my expanded ChatGPT plugin stack and GitHub-based Nicholas AI OS are now connected and operational.

scenes.headline: Your AI stack just changed
scenes.body: ChatGPT is no longer working as a collection of isolated conversations. The connected tools can now be routed around the job you actually want done.

scenes.headline: Specialist tools are connected
scenes.body: Research, email, calendar, CRM, finance, design, websites, analytics, market data and other specialist capabilities can be selected when they are the right fit.

scenes.headline: GitHub adds persistence
scenes.body: Nicholas AI OS now has a private repository where reusable code, routing rules, workflow definitions and automation can live permanently and be versioned.

scenes.headline: A plain-English request can become a job
scenes.body: ChatGPT can write a structured job into GitHub. That commit can trigger an Action, run deterministic code, verify the result and package the finished artifact.

scenes.headline: This video is the proof
scenes.body: The MP4 you are watching was requested in chat, rendered by GitHub Actions with FFmpeg, checked automatically and returned as an artifact without using Replit or a paid render API.

scenes.headline: Next: production video mode
scenes.body: The same pipeline can be upgraded with August Nick narration, licensed or generated visuals, captions, branding and stronger QA while keeping GitHub as the durable execution layer.
